featured_reviews.name: Sarika Periwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shenvi School of Dance is an excellent choice for dance training. My daughter has been a part of this institution for over a year now, and here's what makes it stand high above other dance classes in my opinion....
1. The founders, Kiran Shenvi and his wife Varsha are deeply involved with the minutest details of how the school is run.
2. This is a proper "school" that teaches various forms of dance. It has a curriculum with levels, and children get promoted to higher levels as they learn the techniques and skills. It's not just about picking a song and dancing to it (though that's a part of it, of course), it's about learning various advanced dance techniques through every dance session, and then progressing to the next level.
3. Kiran Shenvi Sir is the heart and soul of the institution, and his passion for dance trickles down to the entire team of teachers. He personally teaches many classes, and is usually around to supervise other classes conducted by his team.
4. The entire team is very friendly and welcoming. It feels like home for the kids. They just love going to class.
5. The setup is preferable to other celebrity dance schools with branches all over, where it's highly unlikely you'll ever get to learn under the founding teacher.
6. Their studio is newly renovated with a wonderful ambience that makes you wanna dance.
7. My daughter's dance skills have greatly improved.
Overall, when I was looking for dance classes for my daughter over a year back and took some trials in my area, Shenvi School of Dance really stood out. And today, after a year, we're really happy we chose this school.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Honestly, I can’t say enough good things about Shenvi School of Dance. My daughter’s been going here for Jazzhop and Contemporary, and what I’ve seen in just a short span is nothing short of amazing. It's not just about dance steps or technique—this school genuinely brings out the best in each child.
What really sets it apart is the ethos behind it all. There’s a deep-rooted belief here that every child has something special within them, and the focus isn’t on who’s the flashiest or the fastest—it’s on helping each one grow at their own pace, in their own way. They don’t just teach movement—they nurture confidence, individuality, and joy.
Kiran Shenvi, the founder, is the real heart and soul behind it. His vision goes way beyond just skill or talent. He sees dance as a way for kids to express themselves, to grow emotionally and mentally, not just physically. He’s not interested in cookie-cutter dancers— he wants each child to shine in their light. And you can feel that energy the moment you walk into the studio.
There’s no pressure, no competition, just pure encouragement and passion. My daughter comes out of every class beaming—more confident, more free, and more in love with dance than ever before.
Shenvi School of Dance isn’t just a place to learn steps. It’s a space where kids find their voice, their rhythm, and their strength. Couldn’t ask for more and couldn’t be more grateful to have found SSD!

featured_reviews.name: Udita Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: This studio feels like home to me. The flooring is amazing..it really supports every move and makes dancing so enjoyable. Absolutely loved the decor too..it’s a perfect mix of style and cozy comfort and you can tell it’s made with love. It’s a great space for creative work, shoots and more. Plus, it’s very close from Bandra station, which makes it super easy to get to. During the day, the natural sunlight fills the studio and adds warmth and positive energy. There are regular dance classes, yoga sessions and workshops here. As someone who visits often, I highly recommend using the space in your own way and enjoying every bit of it. ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Sonia Govani
featured_reviews.review_text: Movement Hub a place I called home way before this space was in existence. The Hub is actually not just a physical space but a space to explore, to move and find yourself. Kunal the Director of the Movement Hub is a person who makes you feel welcome and at home whoever you might be and whatever stage you are at with your dancing. This new space we have been given to call our home is just as magical as the idea behind the Hub. It’s a space which you won’t find anywhere in Mumbai with sprung flooring, a warmup area and a cute office for the team and their guests. The studio about 1000 sq feet is a nice quiet space for people to move comfortably in. The unique fact is the wall with the beautiful mural is not straight but curved, it flows just like we do when we move. The changing room and bathroom super clean and spotless which is quite a nice thing to see in a community space in Mumbai. All the other facilities, Pooja, Shahan, Pranit and Dipen are so amazing dancers and movers as well and learnt a lot from them as well as Kunal over the last few years in the Hub. Like it says “ home is where the heat is and the heart is where the Hub is” I would definitely recommend this place to everyone who wants to just move and enjoy

featured_reviews.name: Aayush Kumaran
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are someone who loves to DANCE, wants to EXPLORE dance styles, find your niche, and GROW as a dancer then this is guaranteed to be the best place for you. I’ve been dancing in classes and workshops across different countries, and I can assure you that The Movement Hub is one of the best places for a dancer to thrive. For those who are new to dance: The studio provides classes across various dance styles and music genres. You can take the single class workshops and have a super fun experience whenever you wish! If you want to keep learning, you will definitely improve in leaps and bounds by joining their month long workshops.
For those who have been dancing for a while: The choreographers here have a very well rounded approach to dance, helping you understand the nuances of movement. They teach you not only the vocabulary of dance within their specific styles, but also help you train the physical and mental aspects of it, ultimately helping you GROW as a dancer. After training here, I definitely saw a huge improvement in my quality of movement and performance.
Lastly, the space and the community are extremely welcoming. There is no pressure to excel, but the desire for it will come from you naturally when you immerse yourself in such a loving and encouraging environment.
Thankful that Mumbai’s dance scene has a place like this now.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Radhakrishnan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Grateful for this space all day everyday! None like it in Mumbai offering solid dance training with some of the best dancers in every style you can think of.😍 The studio is super accessible on Linking road, Bandra. It also has fresh sunlight coming in throughout the day for all your aesthetic shoot needs and turns into a completely different vibe at night! 😌
Definitely gonna be living out of this Hub now! 👀
